regime_context: TSX thematic landscape shows broad eligibility (69% of themes) with Big Banks as the clear leader (high durability, full breadth, but crowded). Absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control; this note leans on that edge for risk-aware direction, not return prediction. No single-narrative dominance; challenger Pipelines has strong trend health but not yet confirmed handoff.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream: strong trend health (durability 0.77, trend Hurst, breadth 1.0) positions it as a potential challenger to Big Banks. Watch for a confirmed handoff (margin reversal and durability sustains). Kill criterion: if Big Banks maintain leadership and the margin widens back above 0.8, or Pipelines’ durability drops below 0.5, the watch is off.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks remain the top-ranked theme with absolute-trend eligibility, high durability (0.72), and perfect breadth (1.0), suggesting a robust uptrend. Crowding (z=1.2) is a sizing caution, not a fade signal; the validated trend gate supports maintaining exposure to avoid drawdown risk.
evidence: Durability bar 0.72 (well above 0.5 threshold, mixed Hurst but high persistence)
Leading rank and healthy rotation margin (vs challenger 0.673) – not yet challenged
theses.dissent: Crowding flag could amplify reversals if macro shocks hit Financials; mixed Hurst may indicate trend quality less reliable than trend-tagged themes.

falsifier.text: If absolute-trend gate flips to ineligible (score/trend indicator breaks support) OR durability bar drops below 0.5 during the horizon, the overweight call is invalidated.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Despite absolute-trend eligibility, Base Metals & Copper exhibits extremely low breadth (0.111) and below-critical durability (0.47), signaling a fragile, highly concentrated uptrend. The risk of a shake-out is elevated, so we lean underweight to control potential drawdown – consistent with the gate's drawdown-avoidance philosophy.
evidence: Durability bar 0.47 (<0.5, borderline failure for trend health)
Breadth only 0.111 – only a tiny subset of metals stocks carry the trend
Mixed Hurst tag suggests no strong trending persistence
Copper often macro-sensitive; unscheduled macro news share is 100%, adding fragility risk
theses.dissent: The theme is still eligible (absolute trend up); if base metals have a sharp, broad-based bounce, missing it could hurt relative performance. This is a risk-control lean, not a return call.

falsifier.text: If breadth expands above 0.5 and durability bar rises above 0.6 while eligibility remains intact, the underweight call would be wrong.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
